Package index

All functions

Segment with an assumed (not measured) deflection

Convert polar (azimuth/distance) measurements to XY

Convert triangulation measurements to XY

Create an empty evidence log
file_hash()
SHA-256 hash of files
furniture()

Catalogue of object types with default height, colour and label
furniture_footprint()
Footprint polygons of scene objects
furniture_from_corners()
Axis-aligned object from two measured opposite corners
furniture_table()
Summary table of scene objects for reports
impact_angle()

Convergence of two trajectories
log_custody()
Record a custody event
log_item()
Add an evidence item to a log
opening()
A door or window segment for scene plots
origin_zone()
Possible origin of fire at assumed muzzle heights
path_deflections()
Deflection angles and joint consistency of a path

plot_trajectories()
Plot trajectories in plan or elevation view with uncertainty
plot_wall_elevation()
Elevation view of one wall
